oral_examination.oral_examination: 27 Deep and large cavities were found on the maxillary surface. After probing and percussion, the teeth were not loose and the gums were not red or swollen. CBCT showed that deep caries penetrated the pulp, and no obvious abnormality was found in the apex.

treatment_plan.definitive: Root canal treatment and crown restoration are recommended.
treatment_plan.notes: Ask for follow-up consultation if you feel unwell. Bite a cotton roll for 40 minutes. Do not brush your teeth or rinse your mouth for 24 hours. You can eat and drink after 2 hours. It is recommended that the food should not be too hot.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and consider the patient's informed request. I took an intraoral CT scan today.
